limitations: Quench groups are post-hoc, chosen by participants and confounded with other actions.
Batches and queries are nested observations, not independent researcher repeats.
Interval inclusion of source means is descriptive, not a universal uncertainty criterion.
Source notes, K1, Q and K2 are distinct time points; no qualitative label is assigned by code.
